summary: The full committee sends an unresolved seating dispute to members from several other delegations.
realLife: The August report identified five states represented on the subcommittee charged with reporting back on Mississippi after the first credentials hearing.
gates: The full credentials committee has deferred a ruling and appointed a subcommittee.
inGame: needs: a referral from the full committee and the subcommittee’s returned recommendation.

turns.pulledBy: The smaller group agrees on facts but splits on the remedy.
turns.writesBack: The full committee receives a divided report.

turns.what: The subcommittee recommends a single slate.
turns.pulledBy: A witness supplies the missing return.
turns.writesBack: The recommendation goes back for a full committee vote.
